objective: Define separate offline calibration and escalation measurements for applicability, outcome, and downstream-impact confidence.
assumptions: Confidence values are agent reports rather than calibrated probabilities
Synthetic labels can be collected without provider access
unknowns: Calibration and escalation thresholds require empirical evaluation
invariants: The three confidence dimensions remain separately recorded
A confidence score is not treated as a probability without calibration evidence
Escalation evidence is separate from outcome evidence
acceptance_predicates: Each dimension has an operational label
A synthetic high-impact low-confidence case escalates
A bounded low-impact case can act
No threshold is presented as deployment validated
